title: Image Recognition via Vaisman--Neifeld's Geometry
summary: We introduce a new approach to the reconstruction of hidden structures from incomplete data, unifying techniques from geometric integration and topological analysis within the frameworks of Vaisman and Neifeld. Our method employs a refined geometric decomposition of configuration spaces into invariant foliations and moment maps, thereby addressing the intrinsic ambiguities of underdetermined inverse problems.
